newsitem.title: UK: NWE OIL PRODUCTS MOSTLY FIRMER.
newsitem.headline: NWE OIL PRODUCTS MOSTLY FIRMER.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly higher on Tuesday, traders said.
Gas oil rose $1 a tonne in line with September IPE, which settled at $170.75 a tonne. Heating oil barges for second half August traded at August IPE +$1.25, $1.50 and $1.75 fob ARA.
Gasoline was $1-2 a tonne firmer on the back of renwewed U.S. gasoline futures buying. A second half barge traded in the morning at $216 fob Rotterdam.
High sulphur fuel oil barges moved up a little to $96 fob on reported scarcity of prompt supplies. Cargoes were mixed with Russian cracked offered a little lower at two means +$1.
Non-Russian steady at the $93/$94 cif mark.
